scope: Complete production BrowserPreferences and BrowserAddressPolicy plus exact MainActivity.dispatchBrowser method. Controlled Android Context/SharedPreferences/Intent/Uri/Activity, catalog availability and BrowserActivity-open adapters. Checks default/migration values, URL-only homepage validation, same-editor preference writes and commit failure propagation, exact routing bypasses and cold/warm session retention. Main onCreate/onNewIntent integration is source-inspected, not executed on Android. No WebView provider, runtime, cookies, network or device performance execution.
